title: Cursor Cuts Prices, Adds Enterprise Controls
excerpt: The free-wheeling era of unlimited AI coding assistance is officially over. Cursor's aggressive price cuts and new enterprise spend controls signal the industry has hit a wall on unsustainable 'all-you-can-eat' token pricing.
post_draft:
The unlimited AI coding era just ended.

Cursor's latest pricing move signals something bigger: the 'all-you-can-eat' token model was never sustainable.

We're breaking down what's really happening—why price cuts don't mean victory for developers, and what enterprise spend controls actually mean for your workflow.

This shift matters because it reshapes how teams will access AI coding tools. The race to undercut competitors on price is giving way to a reckoning on actual value and control.

If you're building with AI or managing a development team, the economics are changing fast. Understanding the tokenomics matters now more than ever.

Read the full story to see where this market is heading and what it means for your stack.
